description: This file defines the ClearField class, which implements a method operation for the minilang framework in Apache OFBiz. It provides functionality to clear (set to null) a specified field in the environment map during method execution, and includes a factory class for creating instances based on XML element configuration.

classes.name: ClearField
classes.description: Implements a method operation that clears a specified field in the environment map during minilang execution. It validates attributes from the XML element, and provides an execution method to set the environment variable to null.

classes.name: ClearFieldFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating ClearField instances from XML elements; adheres to the Factory interface for method operations.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the clear-field operation by setting the specified environment variable to null.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the ClearField operation.

methods.name: createMethodOperation
methods.description: Factory method to create a new ClearField instance from an XML element.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name identifier for the factory, i.e., 'clear-field'.
